title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E02 — Raising the Bar
On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation
Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen
Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E05 — Designed to Dine
Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E06 — The Backyard Blueprint
Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

title: Serving Up Style
description:

description:
S01 E03 — This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E04 — Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E06 — The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E01 — Desert Beginnings
DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home; Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E02 — Concrete Chaos & Joshua Tree Charm
Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E03 — Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E04 — Living With Leo
Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E05 — A Ton of Potential
Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E06 — Anchored in Stone
Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E06 — Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E04 — Once Upon a Time: Fairy Tale Homes
Jillian explores some of the most whimsical homes in Southern California: the famed Hobbit Apartments in Culver City, a home built into a bridge, and a historic Storybook home filled with charm and a storied past.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E02 — Container Homes: All Shapes and Sizes
Jillian discovers two homeowners who have taken containers-and creativity-to extraordinary new heights; Sean's property is a sprawling estate crafted from five containers and Kylie is in the middle of building a massive yoga retreat.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E03 — Off-Grid Living: The Creative Space
Jillian dives headfirst into an off-grid dream when she meets Chris at his one-of-a-kind Quonset hut in Joshua Tree and gets a crash course in living off the beaten path-without sacrificing style.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E01 — Marcela Valladolid: A Chef's Kitchen on the Coast
The one and only Chef Marcela Valladolid invites Matthew for a tour of her stunning historic San Diego home and lush edible garden plus a hands-on lesson in crafting the perfect taco and a signature salsa.

S02 E01 — Collected Chic: Genevieve Gorder's NYC Apartment
Step into Manhattan's Chelsea neighborhood for a look inside designer Genevieve Gorder's home; in her most ambitious project yet, Genevieve combined two neighboring apartments into a singular, soul-filled home for herself and her daughter.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S02 E02 — Caroline Winkler's Cozy Space in DC
Step inside the charming 600-square-foot Washington, D.C., apartment of interior design YouTuber Caroline Winkler; bathed in natural light, every corner reflects a keen eye for detail and a passion for making a house entirely one's own.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E02 — Margot & Josh's Teal Transformation
Margot and Josh spent years perfecting every room in the house but overlooked the bedroom they use daily; Drew steps in with some bedroom inspiration, transforming their space on a series of creative dates.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E03 — Fran & Theresa's Family-Friendly Haven
Fran and Theresa's brand-new home is bustling - especially with 13 grandkids; their mission is to create a safe, family-friendly haven; with a long list of upgrades and no idea where to start, they need a hand.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E07 — Meadows and Modernism
Levi visits two retreats that celebrate open spaces and minimalist design; he starts at the Alto A-Frame, an elevated architectural gem nestled beside a creek; next, he tours the Timber Haus, a Scandinavian-inspired stay tucked in a field of florals.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S02 E07 — Tiny Treehouses of Texas & Modern Mountaintop Dome Home
Levi debunks the myth that everything is bigger in Texas as he explores the tiny treehouses of HoneyTree Farm; artistic in design and perched among sturdy live oaks, the Acorn and Leaf treehouses both feature three levels of living and outdoor space.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E05 — Peaks of Ringgold
Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays; first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary; just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S03 E02 — Tiny Boutique BNBs & Mini Mountain ModCabins
Levi heads to the Adirondack mountains to check out two boutique stays on Acadia Estate; visiting the Scandinavian-style ModCabins in Asheville, N.C.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E03 — Tracks and Tranquility
Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E01 — Heights of the Evergreen State
Levi heads to Issaquah at Ananda, a modern sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the Raging River; next, he travels to Ashford to visit Treehouse Mt. Rainier, a rustic-elegant escape supported entirely by eight towering trees.

Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

title: Hometown Heroes
description:
S01 E03 — The Imagination Library's Magical Makeover
One of Dolly Parton's most heartfelt legacies is the Imagination Library, sparking a love of reading in children across the globe. Now, actress and author Danica McKellar and designer Julie Couch give the headquarters a heartwarming makeover.

title: Serving Up Style
description:
S01 E11 — The Thanksgiving Table & More
Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E09 — An Eclectic Brooklyn Townhouse Defined by Fashion
Travel to Brooklyn to visit the vibrant townhouse of multidisciplinary artists Skylar Marshai and Temi Ibisanmi; featuring a vinyl room, curated treasures and a striking collection of artwork, every space reflects their eye for fashion and color.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E01 — Kimberly & Justin's Dodecagon Dream
Kimberly and Justin, (Drew's 98 Degrees bandmate!) are in need of an overhaul for their twelve-sided, dodecagon dream house; they've got a list of projects, from transforming their bedroom and office, to tackling the massive attic.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E02 — Margot & Josh's Teal Transformation
Margot and Josh spent years perfecting every room in the house but overlooked the bedroom they use daily; Drew steps in with some bedroom inspiration, transforming their space on a series of creative dates.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E03 — Fran & Theresa's Family-Friendly Haven
Fran and Theresa's brand-new home is bustling - especially with 13 grandkids; their mission is to create a safe, family-friendly haven; with a long list of upgrades and no idea where to start, they need a hand.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E03 — Chic Hacks: Style, Flights & Gluten-Free Delights
Stylist Chellie Carlson shows Sabrina tricks for leveling up her wardrobe, cookbook author Danielle Walker spices things up in the kitchen, and comedienne Trish Suhr delivers laughs and next-level travel hacks that'll have you packing like a pro.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E04 — The High Low Life
Trainer Keon Dorsey brings the burn, stylist Caroline Baudino shows how to look ultra-chic on a budget, and journalist Natalie Morales wraps it up with an impressive, budget-friendly dinner you can make in no time.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E05 — Stars & Celebrations
Eden Passante drops by with pro tips for entertaining, Matthew Hoffman gets a crash course on crafting the perfect home scent, and Danielle Page reveals how to embrace your zodiac sign; it's a masterclass in hosting, ambiance, and cosmic vibes.

S01 E06 — The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation
Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen
Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E05 — Designed to Dine
Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E06 — The Backyard Blueprint
Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

title: Serving Up Style
description:
S01 E11 — The Thanksgiving Table & More
Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E03 — Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E04 — Living With Leo
Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E05 — A Ton of Potential
Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E06 — Anchored in Stone
Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

title: The Reveal
description:
S06 E01 — It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

title: The Reveal
description:
S05 E07 — Coloring Outside the Classic Cottage
Just outside of Charleston, Mary Welch Fox brings her signature edge to what looks like a classic cottage-until the front door swings open; inside, it's anything but expected: color-drenched walls, bold wallpaper, and fearless style at every turn.

title: The Reveal

description:
S01 E01 — Marcela Valladolid: A Chef's Kitchen on the Coast
The one and only Chef Marcela Valladolid invites Matthew for a tour of her stunning historic San Diego home and lush edible garden plus a hands-on lesson in crafting the perfect taco and a signature salsa.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E02 — Chris Scott: A Top Chef Talks Biscuits, Jazz and Aprons
Chef Chris Scott, Top Chef finalist, restaurateur, and author, welcomes Matthew into his bucolic New Jersey home for an afternoon filled with flavor, fascinating stories, and a deep dive into Chris's legendary biscuit recipe.

title: Serving Up Style
description:
S01 E11 — The Thanksgiving Table & More
Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S02 E01 — Collected Chic: Genevieve Gorder's NYC Apartment
Step into Manhattan's Chelsea neighborhood for a look inside designer Genevieve Gorder's home; in her most ambitious project yet, Genevieve combined two neighboring apartments into a singular, soul-filled home for herself and her daughter.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S02 E02 — Caroline Winkler's Cozy Space in DC
Step inside the charming 600-square-foot Washington, D.C., apartment of interior design YouTuber Caroline Winkler; bathed in natural light, every corner reflects a keen eye for detail and a passion for making a house entirely one's own.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S02 E03 — London Living With a Fashion Icon
Step inside the London home of fashion designer Wiggy Hindmarch, a sanctuary celebrated for its use of print, texture and color; every room acts as a playful narrative, blending the property's storied history with Wiggy's own expressive flair.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E02 — Home of a Design Icon: The Country Home & Gardens of Bunny Williams
Bunny Williams opens the doors to her 1860s Falls Village estate; explore a rustic barn filled with antiques and an A-frame studio reimagined as a modern retreat; the tour concludes at the Greek temple-inspired pool house crafted from tree trunks.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E08 — Ridge-Top Rituals and Riverfront Rejuvenation
In Rockbridge, Ohio, Levi tours The Pine at Dunlap Ridge which features a wall of windows that overlooks towering pines and farmland; then in Newry, Maine, Levi discovers The Cabin at Bear River, a luxurious escape inspired by Japandi design.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E02 — Hocking Hills Hideaways
Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E06 — Geometric Gems and Storybook Stays
Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale; he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome; then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E04 — Innovation and Inlets
Levi explores the Sunshine State to find unique stays; he starts in Orlando at the Micro House, the state's first 3D-printed micro home; then, he heads to Key Largo to board Stay Ombi, a floating bungalow anchored in Buttonwood Sound.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
Rare & Remote Rentals & Trailblazing Treehouses
Starting with a ferry ride, Levi discovers two remote Washington rentals; the Wolf Den is a modern cabin with cedar-lined cathedral ceilings; Earthlight Villa is a tiny villa with an impressive deck; Levi visits the Copper Fox treehouse.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E01 — Heights of the Evergreen State
Levi heads to Issaquah at Ananda, a modern sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the Raging River; next, he travels to Ashford to visit Treehouse Mt. Rainier, a rustic-elegant escape supported entirely by eight towering trees.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E07 — Meadows and Modernism
Levi visits two retreats that celebrate open spaces and minimalist design; he starts at the Alto A-Frame, an elevated architectural gem nestled beside a creek; next, he tours the Timber Haus, a Scandinavian-inspired stay tucked in a field of florals.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E03 — Tracks and Tranquility
Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E05 — Peaks of Ringgold
Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays; first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary; just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S05 E10 — Sleek & Scandinavian Cozy Cabins; Tiny Treehouse Overlooks
Levi ventures to Nowhere, an upscale nature retreat outside of Austin, Texas and Tall Stuga, a modern, Scandinavian-themed cabin in eastern Kentucky; he also visits the Georgia mountains where he visits two treehouses perched atop hillsides.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E01 — Living in Art: Kaleidoscopic Homes
Imagine stepping into a kaleidoscope, where colors, shapes, and textures collide; that's exactly what Jillian experiences as she explores the iconic Mosaic Tile House in beachy, boho Venice and the Rainbow House in the desert oasis of Palm Springs.
